The full audit is above. Here is the unfiltered verdict:

The system is functional but operating on borrowed time. Several issues are not theoretical — they are almost certainly active failures right now:

Stop everything and do this today:

Rotate your Supabase keys. Your anon key has been sent to Claude and Gemini servers in every session. It is in the context file. That key is not secret anymore.

Fix "customers" → "companies" in app/rep/page.tsx. The company autocomplete in the daily report — your most-used feature — is querying a table that no longer exists by that name. Reps are either seeing no suggestions or the whole query is silently failing. Every activity submitted manually (no autocomplete) has company_id = null, which means your activity-to-company reporting is empty.

Open Supabase dashboard → Authentication → Policies and actually read them. The schema.sql says shared_with in the RLS policies but the column was dropped and replaced with junction tables. If those policies were never updated, your rep access control is either broken (reps see nothing) or too permissive (reps see everything).

Check duplicate_flags column names. The application queries company_id_1 but the schema creates customer_id_1. The duplicates page is almost certainly returning zero results.

The highest long-term risk is not technical — it is that the system was built in sessions you cannot fully understand, by AI tools you switch between, with no local environment to test safely. The next time a bad commit reaches production, you will have no rollback path, no error logs, and no way to debug it except paste the error into Claude and hope.

The data model underneath all this is actually solid. Fix the immediate bugs, set up a staging environment, and the foundation is worth building on.

Key corrections I need to make from the previous audit:

Sales Coordinator role - Previous audit flagged it as potentially broken. Reality: it IS a real operational role with specific permissions. Coordinators create quotations and invoice records, see all companies/projects (names/context) but not rep-private details.

Quotations - Previous audit suggested reps creating quotations as an issue. Reality: Only coordinators create quotations. Reps only view. This is INTENTIONAL.

Invoices - Not really audited in first pass. There's no dedicated invoice table in the schema - this is a gap that needs to be flagged.

customers vs companies table bug - This remains a REAL bug. The rep daily report page queries from("customers") but the table is named companies.

Rep visibility - Rep seeing all companies in app/rep/companies/page.tsx is actually a bug - it should only show companies assigned to them via company_reps. The current query has no filter.

Daily report logic - The audit called sqm_expected in daily reports a problem. But per business rules, reps DO manually enter sqm_done and sqm_expected. This is intentional for now, but the business wants this to be more event-driven eventually.

Duplicate_flags column names - schema.sql uses customer_id_1/customer_id_2 but app code uses company_id_1/company_id_2. This is still a real discrepancy.

Team page role dropdown - Only shows rep and manager options, missing sales_coordinator and marketing roles. This is a real gap.

Marketing approval flow - Marketing company registration needs manager approval, but currently all registrations go through the same pending → active flow.

Loss reason - Not enforced when stage = Lost. Still a real gap.
